plugins.name: aris
plugins.description: ARIS (Autonomous Research In Sleep) - academic research automation skills

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Base bundle — runtime hooks, MCP (LSP + AST grep + Codex), generic agents, and common slash skills (commit/PR, review, handoff, docs, rules)

plugins.name: frame
plugins.description: Opt-in code-work guardrails behind per-project markers (.inlay) — one dispatcher routes hook events to active guardrails

plugins.name: expert
plugins.description: Advanced/heavyweight tools — Python REPL MCP server (future ralph-like workflow skills)

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: Heads-Up Display statusline — live session state from Claude Code stdin (cwd, git branch, rate limits, context %, model)

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research workflow skills - journal, plan, report, commit

plugins.name: usefable
plugins.description: Fable-tier agents — fable- prefixed top-model variants of core's executor and review/verification agents

plugins.name: personal
plugins.description: Strictly personal environment customization — session-injected personal instructions and personal workflow skills. Not meant for sharing

plugins.name: ws
plugins.description: Workspace conventions — wsinit scaffolding, workspace rule documents (read via core's ruleof CLI), ticket skills and the wsticket CLI

plugins.name: roleas
plugins.description: Session role skills over the ws ticket system — orchestrator issues and delegates tickets, worker executes a delegated ticket
